summary: Reviews, tutorials, workflows and tool comparisons. Viewers want a verdict or a result fast and proof that it works; screen footage and numbers carry credibility.

archetypes.name: Result first workflow
archetypes.when_to_use: Showing how you do something with a tool or setup.

structure.goal: Show the end result and promise how long it takes
State what you need in one breath
Walk through the workflow in the order the viewer will do it
structure.notes: Screen capture with a face cam inset

structure.goal: Compare before and after with a number
Point to the template, link or next video
Give the verdict and who it is for
Buy, wait or skip, then CTA
Ask which one wins and why it matters
Pick one and tell who should choose the other

hook_styles.pattern: I [did X] in [N minutes / dollars / steps]
hook_styles.example: I cut my editing time from 4 hours to 40 minutes
Stop exporting from your timeline. Do this instead
Is the new laptop actually worth 400 dollars more?

hook_styles.pattern: I switched to [tool] last month and [surprising consequence]
hook_styles.example: I switched my whole workflow last month and broke everything

pacing.notes: Fast cuts on screen recordings; zoom or highlight on every click.

shot_conventions.note: Cut to the result by second 2

shot_conventions.framing: desk view, product and screen visible
shot_conventions.b_roll: gear laid out or app home screen

shot_conventions.framing: full screen with face cam inset
shot_conventions.note: Zoom on each click; add step numbers

shot_conventions.framing: before and after side by side

cta_patterns: Grab the free template from the link below
Subscribe for the next workflow breakdown
Comment which tool I should test next
common_risks: Screen text too small on a phone
Burying the verdict at the end
Sponsor read before delivering any value
